item.title: Nvidia vs Broadcom: Dueling AI financing bets, Contrasting risks
item.summary: Nvidia has unveiled a US$500 billion artificial intelligence (AI) compute financing plan with six Wall Street giants—Goldman Sachs Group, Blackstone, Apollo Global Management, KKR, BlackRock, and Brookfield—highlighting its push to win new startup customers and the growing complexity of its financing structure. The plan also underscores its strategic split from rival Broadcom and rising concerns over a possible industry bubble.
